newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Petrochem off on reported selloff.
newsitem.headline: China Petrochem off on reported selloff.

text.p: Taiwan's China Petrochemical Development Corp fell at mid-morning on Thursday on reports that state-run Chinese Petroleum would sell off its China Petrochemical shareholdings, brokers said.
After 80 minutes, at 0220 GMT, China Petrochemical had fallen T$1.3 or three percent to T$42.1, while the overall index was down a scant 0.13 percent.
The Economic Daily News reported on Thursday that Chinese Petroleum, Taiwan's oil monopoly, was preparing to sell its 145 million shares of China Petrochemical Corp.
Company executives could not be reached for comment.
"The huge share offer will increase sharply the supply of China Petrochemical shares, dampening its share prices in the near term," said Golden Securities research chief Albert Lin.
China Petrochemical likely would drift lower to test technical support at T$41, Lin said.
China Petrochemical transferred to private hands when its state stake fell to 37 percent from 80 percent in June 1994.
